'''Hym Jemuro''' was an individual that held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Eternal Alliance fleet|fleet]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="CODEX" /> In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="KOTET dates">{{TOR_updates|5.0}}</ref> after the Eternal Alliance's victory [[War against Zakuul|over]] the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]], members of the [[Eternal Empire military]] started joining the Eternal Alliance, which caused fear and distrust among the Alliance ranks.<ref name="CODEX" />

The fear and distrust led to the [[Speciesism/Legends|xenophobic]] Captain Jemuro to imprison all [[Skytrooper]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] stationed aboard his [[Hym Jemuro's capital ship|capital ship]], claiming that they were plotting a mutiny. His claims were disapproved when two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later, his [[Capital ship/Legends|ship]] was damaged navigating the [[Kauron asteroid field]]. The imprisoned skytroopers escaped from the cargo hold and repaired the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], saving him and his crew. The event led to most of the Eternal Alliance accepting the [[Zakuulan]] forces, which frustrated the then-disgraced Jemuro.<ref name="CODEX" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hym Jemuro was mentioned in "Zakuulan Allies," a codex entry in the [[2016]] digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Site">{{TORweb|url=eternal-throne|text=Knights of the Eternal Throne}}</ref>
